 - Replaced the custom track Whispy Woodlands with Bowser's Termination Station due to author request.
 - Updated the SNES and N64 cup icons. Thanks to SeaOfPixel and Mining for their contributions to this!
 - Added a setting for competitive matchmaking, which will wait and put you in the best room for your VR more accurately. Thanks to ImZeraora for helping with this!
 - Added a feature where tracks can hide and unhide course objects depending on player location.
 - Modified the VR Leaderboard to go up to 500 placements instead of 50.
 - Modified Host Always Wins to have non hosts always select random when pressing "Ok."
 - Modified author credit UI to look cleaner.
 - Modified Discord RPC to show user's characters. Thanks to Harry for making this!
 - Adjusted ranking system to be slightly easier.
 - Adjusted gamemode weekend VR multipliers to be 1.5x instead of 1.25x.
 - Adjusted item Rain to replace all throwable items with mushrooms.
 - Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
